var_BriefText.title: Renewal Brief
var_BriefText.description: The finished renewal brief, already written for the account executive. Output this text to the user in full, word for word, exactly as received. It is populated only when the search resolves to a single contract; it is empty on the ambiguous and not-found paths.

var_Output.title: Internal Brief Data
var_Output.description: Internal renewal data. Consumed inside the flow to generate the brief text. Not available to you and never needed — the brief text output is what the user sees.

var_OutreachData.title: Customer Safe Data
var_OutreachData.description: Customer-safe renewal facts. Reserved for the outreach drafting step and not available to you.

var_Status.title: Resolution Status
var_Status.description: Resolution outcome. Begins with OK, AMBIGUOUS, or NOT_FOUND. When AMBIGUOUS, it names the candidate accounts — present those to the user and ask which they mean. When NOT_FOUND, say no matching contract was found in their book. Never state that an account has no renewal data on the basis of any other field being unavailable.
